race.description: Hahn Country Boosted Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: CERANO MAGIC (1) resumes from a lengthy spell. Excellent debut with a close-up third over 1000m at Port Macquarie last March. Played up before the start and was slow into stride with a dismal last over 1005m at Grafton on April 7. Trialled well and has a host of gear changes for this. Sure to be thereabouts. SEATON MOON (5) Farnan mare out of Elfee on debut for the Kelley yard. Looked good when second at her only public trial at Canberra. Lugging bit goes on and gets every chance from the gate. SECOND WITNESS (6) returns after four months in the paddock and now in the Joseph Burgees yard. Never comfortable in the heavy going when fifth over 1180m at Gundagai. Claim helps and can take a hand in the finish. CECIL PEAK (10) Stratum Star filly from Beep Beep on debut for the Peter Bloomfield yard. Looked good when winning her recent trial over 1100m. Drawn awkwardly but must be kept safe.
